commitment_derivation.description: SHA-256 of the JCS-canonicalized failure histogram INCLUDING the decay window_end, per the hash(histogram, window_end) convention agreed in autogen#7888
commitment_derivation.storage: single bytes32 per (agent, scope); full decayed history stays off-chain

usage.counter_answers_bool: revoke predicate - has this (chain, tool) combination failed past threshold
usage.histogram_answers_distribution: routing/escalation pricing - decayed weight feeds accelerate/heal/turn ladder off-chain
usage.thresholds_scaled_by: half_life_seconds, so 5 failures in an hour outranks 5 over a month
